best: The BQ25756 four-switch stage reads as a textbook left-to-right power path (input sense, input caps, half-bridge, inductor, half-bridge, output caps, RBAT sense to PACK_P), with titled blocks, setpoint annotations (16.8 V, 4.2 A, 500 kHz) and numbered notes throughout.
worst: Stacked GND/EP pin numbers on U401 and U405 render as an illegible overlapping red blob, plus a stray '(15)' pin marker on U401
The charge controller U403 connects to the power stage (HIDRV/LODRV/BTST/SW/SRP/SRN) only through stub net labels, so gate-drive and sense routing must be traced by name
Uneven page use: the 3V3 and MCU sheets leave the bottom third or more empty while the USB sheet is dense
